jobs.description:
**Date:** Sep 3, 2026
  
  

**Primary Location:** Radnor, PA, US
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
  

**Company:** Lincoln Financial
  
  

**Alternate Locations:** Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)
  
  

**Work Arrangement:**  

**Remote :** Work at home employee residing outside of a commutable distance to an office location.
  
  

**Relocation assistance:** is not available for this opportunity.
  
  

**Hiring Manager:** Nena Ziemba
  
  

**Requisition \#:** 76567
  
  

The Role at a Glance
  
  

We are excited to bring on an EDI Onboarding Specialist to join our Group Protection Operations Team supporting Workplace Solutions.
  
  

Background Details
  
The Group Protection Operations Team will help you grow your technical knowledge and establish strong partnerships (internally/externally) while working in this fast\-paced environment.
  
  

As an EDI Onboarding Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering on EDI onboarding and implementation assignments \& projects. You will support pre\- and post\-sales activity in providing guidance regarding compatibility of proposed onboarding approach with EDI processes. You will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate activities, facilitate automated EDI processing, manage and resolve escalated EDI service issues, and provide a superior onboarding experience for the customer. This opportunity will provide the ability to grow within the group insurance industry while gaining new skills and building strong working relationships. If this sounds like a role for you, please read on!
  
  

What you'll be doing
  
You will maintain knowledge of current and emerging developments and trends in your assigned areas of responsibility, assess their impact, and collaborate with management to incorporate new developments into current and future solutions.
  
You will promote and enhance organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and departmental or enterprise\-wide efforts within your assigned areas of responsibility.
  
You will perform and deliver on routine assignments and projects while applying knowledge of your assigned areas of responsibility.
  
You will identify and communicate process improvements to management that reduce workloads or improve quality within your assigned areas of responsibility.
  
You will implement inbound file feeds for both new services and ongoing maintenance requests, including demographic/eligibility, EOI, Portability and Conversion, RTN, and other relevant proprietary layouts, and you will handle custom installations and historical insertions as needed.
  
You will act as a liaison between internal EDI resources, other internal teams, and third\-party partners to ensure all stakeholders understand optimal policy setup—per EDI guidelines—to support efficient automation and onboarding.
  
You will collaborate with internal EDI resources to test and validate new EDI layouts, systems, and processes.
  
You will participate in calls with brokers and customers and outline the advantages and disadvantages of proposed EDI onboarding approaches.
  
You will coordinate with internal EDI resources and third\-party partners to validate required data fields and ensure appropriate file configurations for successful initial and ongoing data transmission and processing.
  
You will work with third\-party benefits administration platforms to successfully implement EDI files for eligibility, portability/conversion, EOI, and leave management.
  
You will communicate the status of file processing and implementation with stakeholders throughout the onboarding process and provide post‑implementation follow‑up on outstanding issues.
  
You will load test data files into quality software, review upload status reports, and research and resolve issues or errors preventing successful data loading.
  
You will, upon successful test file loading, copy files to the appropriate network location and send confirmation to the client.
  
You will provide file support to installed customers as needed.
  
You will manage and resolve service escalations from internal partners and collaborate with management to deliver effective solutions.
  
You will identify and communicate additional process improvements to management that reduce workloads or improve quality within your assigned areas of responsibility.
  
You will serve as a mentor and technical resource to less‑tenured team members when needed.
  
You will act as a testing resource for specific initiatives as required.
  
What we’re looking for
  
  

**Must\-haves:**  

4 Year/Bachelors Degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelors)
  
1 \- 3\+ Years of experience in EDI processing and automation directly aligned to the specific responsibilities for this role
  
Ability to communicate effectively (verbal/written)
  
Demonstrated strong customer service experience
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  
Apply concepts such as probability, statistics, modeling, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical solutions and work with concepts such as averages and/or variances
  
  

**Nice\-to have:**  

Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with the ability to adapt as needed
  
Application Deadline
  
  

**Level:** 11
  
  

The pay range for this position is $52,500 \- $84,000 with anticipated pay for new hires between the minimum and midpoint of the range and could vary above and below the listed range as permitted by applicable law. Pay is based on non\-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, education, location, licensure requirements, proficiency and qualifications required for the role. The base pay is just one component of Lincoln’s total rewards package for employees. In addition, the role may be eligible for the Annual Incentive Program, which is discretionary and based on the performance of the company, business unit and individual. Other rewards may include long\-term incentives, sales incentives and Lincoln’s standard benefits package.
  
  

Additional Information
  
  

This position may be subject to Lincoln’s Political Contribution Policy. An offer of employment may be contingent upon disclosing to Lincoln the details of certain political contributions. Lincoln may decline to extend an offer or terminate employment for this role if it determines political contributions made could have an adverse impact on Lincoln’s current or future business interests, misrepresentations were made, or for failure to fully disclose applicable political contributions and or fundraising activities. Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our web site or to personal e\-mail accounts of employees of Lincoln Financial are considered property of Lincoln Financial and are not subject to payment of agency fees.
  
  

Lincoln Financial ("Lincoln" or "the Company") is an Equal Opportunity employer and, as such, is committed in policy and practice to recruit, hire, compensate, train and promote, in all job classifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or disability. Opportunities throughout Lincoln are available to employees and applicants are evaluated on the basis of job qualifications. If you are a person with a disability that impedes your ability to express your interest for a position through our online application process, or require TTY/TDD assistance, contact us by calling (866\) 922\-6543\.

MSC is a privately owned global shipping company founded in 1970 by Gianluigi Aponte. As one of the world’s leading container shipping lines with headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, MSC operates in over 675 offices across more than 155 countries worldwide with over 200,000 MSC Group employees. With access to an integrated network of road, rail and sea transport resources which stretches across the globe, the company prides itself on delivering global service with local knowledge.
  
  

MSC is a world leader in global container shipping and a company offering global service with local knowledge. MSC also provides integrated network of road, rail and sea transport resources which stretches across the globe.

Serve as a subject matter expert and key point of contact, providing guidance on customer service processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and collaborating with internal teams to drive service excellence and customer satisfaction.

Coordinate onboarding activities for new and existing customers.
  
Conduct video calls with customers to provide guidance on MSC processes and customer service channels.
  
Support customers throughout the onboarding process and assist in addressing questions and concerns.
  
Identify potential issues and escalate or coordinate resolution with appropriate internal teams.
  
Partner with customer\-facing teams to support operational issue resolution and corrective actions.
  
Maintain customer onboarding records and documentation.
  
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying process inefficiencies and opportunities for enhancement.
  
Monitor onboarding progress and customer interactions to help ensure service standards are met.
  
Presence required on‑site 5 days per week

**English:** Advanced
  
Excellent communication skills
  
Strong customer service mindset, focused, and responsive
  
Strong attention to details
  
Adaptable and flexible to changes in responsibilities
  
Organized, efficient, and able to manage time effectively

Great team player
  
Knowledge of MS Excel with the ability to learn new software
  
Prior experience in supply chain, transportation, shipping, logistics, freight forwarding, customer service, call center, administrative or clerical jobs
  
  

PREFERRED SKILLS, EDUCATION, AND EXPERIENCE
  
  

Prior experience in customer service, or logistics with a focus on customer service and problem resolution
  
Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience in similar role
  
Knowledge of MS Dynamics not necessary but a plus
  
  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
  
  

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  
Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time
  
Must be able to commute to the designated office location
  
Presence required on‑site 5 days per week
  
  

WORK AUTHORIZATION
  
  

Authorization to work in the U.S
  
  

This role requires working on\-site in the office for five days a week, from Monday to Friday. There is no option for fully remote or hybrid work in this role, unless required off\-site duties are being performed.

jobs.title: Web Implementation Consultant/Associate
jobs.description:
**Xplor Technologies** powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI\-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership\-based and service\-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.


We unite popular brands such as **Clubessential**, **foreUP**, **myFitApp**, **Vermont Systems**, **Momence**, **Exerp**, and many more.

  

Join our **Golf \& Club Vertical** asa **Web Implementation Consultant/Associate** to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.


The Web Implementation Consultant will assist with the consultation, configuration and post\-go\-live assistance required to successfully onboard a new or current customer to a new product. The Web Implementation Consultant will work with a Project Manager, other Implementation Specialists and Education to ensure that the client is properly set up and that all members are appropriately trained. They will also work with the Product and Development team on diagnosing and resolving system issues and the rollout of new products. Web Implementation Consultants must be motivated, detail\-oriented, and results\-oriented in this profession. They must coordinate with internal and external resources to ensure successful implementations. The Web Implementation Consultant must possess strong communication skills as they are consulting with customers throughout the life cycle of the project and equally adept at resolving difficult technical challenges should they arise.

 **Some of the things you'll do:**

* Serve as the primary resource for Project Managers as we onboard customers to new products. This entails answering questions during the onboarding process, consulting on product configuration, providing one on one training on new products and post go live support.
* Consult with the client to understand their vision and strategy for their website and provide recommendations and effective techniques for web content.
* In addition to websites, consultation, configuration and training around the following products and processes: Mobile App, Roster Syncs, APIs, Beacons, Geofencing and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
* Determine scope of any custom configurations and builds according to specifications
* Engage with clients on best practices to ensure the unified suite of products is being utilized to full functionality
* Ability to manage multiple clients and projects/tasks simultaneously.
* Create documentation of standard practices for all tasks and projects
* Ability to understand customer business problems and clearly articulate business solutions to solve those problems.
* Conduct quality assurance checks of newly built websites and other products, clearly documenting any issues found throughout and communicating them back to the appropriate team.
* Troubleshoot and root\-cause website and mobile app related issues.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through follow\-up, client responsiveness, and thorough communication.
* Strong internal communication skills including ability to work with all levels of the organization (Project Management, Support, Product Management, Development, Sales).
* Interact with and coordinate the involvement of cross\-functional teams as needed to meet project objectives
* Collaborate with Product Managers on client feedback and feature requests
* Collaborate with Support Staff and Leadership when customers are ready to be transitioned to Support. Call out any unique client configurations and possible knowledge gaps that may need to be addressed in Support.

**Working arrangements:**


Fully Remote in the United States of America**:** You can work fully remote in this position, provided you have eligible working rights in the USA and do not require sponsorship.

 **Qualifications**

**What would make me a good candidate?**


We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever\-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big\-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

 **You'll need:**

* Ability to handle multiple projects across different product lines (Website, CRM, Reservation, Accounting/POS System)
* Operational knowledge of Relational Databases, Database Schema, SQL, VBScript and Microsoft Excel
* Familiarity with JavaScript, API and CSS
* Proficiency with CSS and HTML Knowledge
* Proven work experience in software or website product quality assurance
* Experience in Project Management paired with a strong understanding of customer support.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to articulate ideas clearly, demonstrating patience with users during the training process.
* Detail\-oriented, has strong time and relationship management abilities, and excels in team development.
* Self\-driven with a strong desire to teach clients on best practices and how to get the most out of their products
* Exceptional organizational skills, including attention to detail and multitasking.
* 4\+ years of relevant and progressive experience
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, active listening skills, ability to maintain composure, and self\-motivation are all required.

 *At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences \- people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.*  

  

**Values and Life at Xplor**


Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

* Find a better way
* Do the right thing
* Say it straight
* Win together
* Own the outcome

  

If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.


As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.  

  

**Ready to apply?**


To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can.

  

Got questions? You can email us at talentsupport@xplortechnologies.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Technical Implementation
jobs.description:
**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!**


Ensemble is a leading provider of technology\-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end\-to\-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.


Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!


O.N.E Purpose:

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**The Opportunity:**

The Technical Implementation Senior Analyst serves as a subject matter expert in implementing and configuring technology solutions within a healthcare revenue cycle environment. Ensures successful deployment of systems by translating business requirements into technical specifications, managing integration processes, and supporting client onboarding. Focuses on optimizing workflows, maintaining compliance standards, and delivering high\-quality implementation outcomes that drive operational efficiency. Leads end\-to\-end implementation activities, including requirements gathering, system configuration, testing, and deployment. Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with existing platforms and adherence to client specifications. Develops and maintains documentation, provides technical guidance during project execution, and resolves complex issues to ensure timely delivery. Monitors performance metrics post\-implementation and recommends enhancements to improve system functionality and user experience.

 **Join an award\-winning company**

  

Five\-time winner of “Best in KLAS” 2020\-2022, 2024\-2025


Black Book Research's Top Revenue Cycle Management Outsourcing Solution 2021\-2024


22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019\-2024


Leader in Everest Group's RCM Operations PEAK Matrix Assessment 2024


Clarivate Healthcare Business Insights (HBI) Revenue Cycle Awards for strong performance 2020, 2022\-2023


Energage Top Workplaces USA 2022\-2024


Fortune Media Best Workplaces in Healthcare 2024


Monster Top Workplace for Remote Work 2024


Great Place to Work certified 2023\-2024

* Innovation
* Work\-Life Flexibility
* Leadership
* Purpose \+ Values

  

Bottom line, we believe in empowering people and giving them the tools and resources needed to thrive. A few of those include:

* **Associate Benefits –** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family, including healthcare, time off, retirement, and well\-being programs.
* **Our Culture** – Ensemble is a place where associates can do their best work and be their best selves. We put people first, last and always. Our culture is rooted in collaboration, growth, and innovation.
* **Growth –** We invest in your professional development. Each associate will earn a professional certification relevant to their field and can obtain tuition reimbursement.
* **Recognition –** We offer quarterly and annual incentive programs for all employees who go beyond and keep raising the bar for themselves and the company.

  

Ensemble is an equal employment opportunity employer. It is our policy not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Ensemble also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Corporate Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Business Unit Overview:
**Michael Foods, Inc. is a leader in the food processing and distribution industry with business in egg products, refrigerated grocery and potato products. We offer exciting job possibilities throughout our organization where you can enhance your career, sharpen your talents and make an impact. Join our company and be part of an innovative team that’s First in Food***.*
Location Description: Michael Foods, Inc. located in Gaylord, Minnesota is Minnesota's Healthy Heartland! Gaylord is located in south central Minnesota about an hour west of the Twin Cities and 35 minutes from Mankato, Hutchinson, and New Ulm. As the County Seat, Gaylord is the "Hub of Sibley County." Our location produces liquid egg, hardcook egg, and precooked egg such as scrambled, patties and omelets. Responsibilities:
**POSITION SUMMARY****:**

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Training Coordinator to join our Corporate Food Safety and Quality (FSQ) team. In this pivotal role, you will help shape a culture of excellence by empowering teams to uphold the highest food safety and quality standards across all food manufacturing facilities. You will design, implement, manage, and evaluate training programs that extend beyond compliance to build knowledge, reinforce behaviors, and drive consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement. Leveraging adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies, you will identify training needs, create effective learning materials, and lead initiatives that support organizational capability and performance. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Strategic Design and Develop Training Materials**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead the assessment of company\-wide FSQ training needs in partnership with stakeholders to establish strategic learning priorities.
* Interpret existing standard operating procedures and observe undocumented processes to create clear, structured training content that drives consistency and effective learning.
* Design and develop engaging, role\-specific training materials that support onboarding and ongoing development for facility and corporate team members, using best practices in instructional design and content creation.
* Leverage translation tools and verify translations to support multilingual and diverse audiences.
* Champion the modernization and enhancement of existing training materials to enhance clarity, engagement, and alignment with current practices and expectations.
* Ensure training meets internal standards and external requirements (i.e. FDA, USDA, SQF).
* Align training initiatives with succession planning and leadership development to drive long\-term talent growth and measurable improvements in employee and organizational capabilities.
* Stay current on regulatory changes, industry trends, and innovations in learning and development to continuously evolve training strategies and tools.

**Company\-wide Implementation and Delivery of Training Programs**

* Manage the deployment of training programs related to food safety, quality, and sanitation across all manufacturing facilities, ensuring strategic alignment and consistent execution.
* Deliver Train\-the\-Trainer sessions to empower facilitators with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to lead high\-impact training and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Facilitate engaging classroom, hands\-on, and virtual training sessions for both hourly and salaried employees, across all shifts to ensure accessibility for all team members.

**Training System Management and Oversight**

* Oversee LMS activities, including content uploads, learning plan assignments, reporting, and compliance tracking, while guiding facility teams to ensure accessibility and usability.
* Establish protocols to ensure facilities maintain accurate, audit\-ready training records aligned with corporate, regulatory, and customer requirements.

**Training Evaluation, Optimization and Continuous Improvement**

* Define and monitor key performance indicators to evaluate training effectiveness, identify gaps, and implement targeted improvements.
* Apply data\-driven methods to assess learning outcomes, behavior change, and business impact.
* Continuously update training materials based on process changes, audit results, and insights from employee performance and behavior.


Qualifications:
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* Degree in Instructional Design, Learning Design and Technology, Organizational Development, Organizational Leadership, or a closely related field in Learning and Development or Training.
* 5\+ years of experience in an instructional design related field, preferably in food manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success in leading enterprise\-wide learning initiatives that align with corporate strategy, drive measurable performance improvements, and support organizational transformation.

**EXPERIENCE PREFERRED:**

* Knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including regulatory frameworks such as FSMA, GFSI (e.g., SQF, BRC), HACCP, and GMPs, with experience integrating these into training programs.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Strong communication and engagement skills, with a proven ability to lead through influence, fostering alignment and driving action across cross\-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Skilled in coaching and mentoring facility\-based trainers to elevate training effectiveness and drive sustainable workforce capability development through influential leadership.
* Project management capabilities, including experience with large\-scale rollouts, change management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to simplify complex regulatory and technical content into scalable, learner\-centric training solutions using modern instructional design methodologies.
* Analytical mindset with experience applying data\-driven evaluation models to assess training effectiveness and business impact.
* Proficiency with a wide range of learning technologies and content development tools (e.g. Alchemy Creator, Synthesia, Adobe Premiere Pro, PowerPoint, CoPilot).
* Fluency in multiple languages, such as English and Spanish, is a plus.
* Periodic travel (not to exceed 50%) to lead training development and execution across all facilities.

  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of the work and may not include all the duties associated with this position.
 

: The pay range for this position is $80,166 \- $118,645 per year.
